protocol.selection: minimum 2023 WAPE among raw models and their 2023-chosen blends
protocol.rain_anomaly: mean of the same province-calendar month strictly before the row and no later than the fit's train end
protocol.frozen_2025: one fit on 2019-01..2024-12; lag features still use revealed months before t
protocol.monthly_2025: refit on every month strictly before t, then predict t
